# Darwin Danish

> Computer engineering student and systems builder with an ambition to engineer technology in the motorsport industry in tech & innovation. Specializes in IoT architectures, applied machine learning, embedded systems, and systems engineering.

## Overview
- **Name**: Darwin Danish (Darwin Danish Anak Geramong)
- **Canonical Website**: https://darwindanish.github.io/
- **Location**: Kapit, Sarawak, Malaysia
- **Alma Mater**: Kapit National Secondary School (SMK Kapit)
- **Primary Focus**: Motorsport Technology & Innovation, Formula 1 Telemetry & Aerodynamics Systems, Embedded IoT, Applied Machine Learning, Software Engineering

## Major Achievements & Awards
- **Gold Award — Borneo International Innovation Creativity Competition (BIICC) 2026**: Awarded for engineering ingenuity, creative system architecture, and impactful technological problem-solving in the International Innovation & Technology category.
- **1st Place Champion (Juara Pertama) & RM 1,000 Grand Prize — Pertandingan Reka Cipta Mini Inno Waste 2.0**: Designed and engineered Project Lumina, an intelligent AI-powered interactive waste segregation station constructed from recycled vehicle tires.

## Featured Engineering Projects
- **Project Lumina**: Interactive recycling system equipped with an onboard Raspberry Pi 4, custom offline Picovoice wake-word engine, OpenAI Whisper speech transcription, conversational intelligence, and automated emergency WhatsApp telemetry notifications. Read the full case study at https://darwindanish.github.io/blog/posts/lumina-journey/.
- **Exoplanet Classifier**: Machine learning ensemble pipeline that analyzes astronomical light curves to classify planetary transits and filter false positives with high accuracy. Hosted on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/DarwinDanish/exoplanet-classifier-stacking.

## Technical Skills & Tooling
- **Hardware & Embedded**: Raspberry Pi 4, Arduino, ESP32, Sensor Interfacing (Ultrasonic, Audio, GPIO), Circuit Prototyping
- **Machine Learning & AI**: Python, Scikit-Learn, Ensemble Stacking, Whisper STT, Picovoice Porcupine, Natural Language Interfaces
- **Software & Systems**: TypeScript, Astro, React, Tailwind CSS, Git, Linux/Unix, REST APIs, WebSockets
- **Languages Spoken**: Malay (Native/Bilingual), English (Fluent), German (Working), Spanish (Elementary)
